subject: CSEC Mathematics
question: O is the centre of a circle. A and B are points on the circumference and ∠AOB = 104°. A tangent is drawn at A. Calculate the angle between the tangent and chord AB.
worked_solution: OA = OB, so ∠OAB = (180° − 104°)/2 = 38°. The radius is perpendicular to the tangent. Required angle = 90° − 38° = 52°.
